name: Boxes.dev Cloud Agent Devboxes (Trial)
free_limit: One-time free trial of cloud development boxes; homepage currently advertises 20 compute box-hours, up to 3 awake devboxes plus a template box and 2 projects. Sleeping devboxes do not consume box-hours.
watch_out: This is a finite trial, not a recurring free cloud allowance. Official help/plans-and-box-hours still lists 10 box-hours and 2 awake devboxes, conflicting with the homepage; confirm the allowance in account Billing. Some teams must add a payment method before starting. After trial hours expire, paid access is required. Codex/Claude subscriptions or API usage are separate; compute beyond included trial is not free.
